name: readonly-freeze-rejects-txn
$comment: Per-database read-only freeze (PATCH /admin/db/{db}/readonly): with dbReadOnly set, the engine models a frozen database after seeding — every txn fails with READ_ONLY while reads still execute. Only the error code is asserted (determinism ruling 4). The server's transport-level gating (committer Mutate arm; schedule/workflow/signal client surfaces) is pinned by server/tests/read_only_test.rs, not here — the corpus pins the code and the cross-engine freeze semantics.
